answer.interpretation:
This is our interpretation of your question:

Which 10 towns had the highest median sale price in 2024, among towns with at least 500 sales in 2024?
answer.sql:
WITH __uk_price_paid AS (
  SELECT
    date,
    town,
    YEAR(date) AS year,
    price
  FROM ANALYTICS.UK.UK_PRICE_PAID
)
SELECT
  town,
  COUNT(price) AS sales_count,
  MEDIAN(price) AS median_price
FROM __uk_price_paid
WHERE
  year = 2024
GROUP BY
  town
HAVING
  COUNT(price) >= 500
ORDER BY
  median_price DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

answer.interpretation:
This is our interpretation of your question:

Show the median price paid in England and Wales in 2023 and in 2024, and the percentage change from 2023 to 2024.
answer.sql:
WITH median_2023 AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM SEMANTIC_VIEW(
        ANALYTICS.UK.UK_PRICE_PAID_SEMANTIC
        METRICS median_price
        WHERE uk_price_paid.year = 2023
    )
),
median_2024 AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM SEMANTIC_VIEW(
        ANALYTICS.UK.UK_PRICE_PAID_SEMANTIC
        METRICS median_price
        WHERE uk_price_paid.year = 2024
    )
)
SELECT
    2023 AS year_2023,
    2024 AS year_2024,
    median_2023.median_price AS median_price_2023,
    median_2024.median_price AS median_price_2024,
    median_2024.median_price - median_2023.median_price AS absolute_change,
    (median_2024.median_price - median_2023.median_price) / NULLIF(median_2023.median_price, 0) AS pct_change
FROM median_2023
CROSS JOIN median_2024
 -- Generated by Cortex Analyst (request_id: 8ecac420-9e96-4ff5-b2d2-7b86bd5badfc)
;
